//profile: The graphic profile is declared in two places by decision (ADR 0004). These name them; the profile check asserts they agree. When .io moves into public/, profileContactSurface moves with it.
//licensedFonts: MonoLisa is purchased and this repo is public, so the webfont files stay out of git until the licence covers the web. webFontLicence is the one fact that says whether it does, and it turns the fonts, references and workers checks around together — see docs/runbooks/2026-08-26-monolisa-webfont-cutover.md. licensedFontPattern is what counts as a licensed font file; licensedWebFonts is the exact set the site is allowed to carry once it may carry any.
//sitemapPages: The pages sitemap.xml has to advertise, as repo paths; index.html is the root URL. robots.txt names the sitemap as the crawl entry point and llms-full.txt is linked from nowhere else on the site, so a surface left out of this list is published and undiscoverable at once. robots.txt, sitemap.xml and assets/ are published without being pages and are deliberately absent.
//expectCustomDomain: false until the cutover. Flipping this and adding the route to wrangler.jsonc are the same decision, and the gate fails on one without the other. See docs/runbooks/2026-08-12-pages-to-workers-cutover.md.
